item.title: Ben & Jerry's adds three sundaes to its lineup
item.description: In 2025, Ben & Jerry's offered Dulce De-lish! Sundae, Choco-lotta Cheesecake Sundae, Turtle Sundae and the fan favorite Cookie Vermont-ster sundaes.

item.title: Kerrygold to sell Butter Club merchandise to benefit City Harvest
item.description: All proceeds from the sale will be donated to City Harvest, New York City's largest food rescue organization. Fans can find the exclusive items at the Bombesquad Bazaar, a curated marketplace celebrating female-founded brands, hosted by Cherry Bombe and Shopify in SoHo to honor Galentine's Day.

item.title: Why is ice cream both ultra-processed and hyperpalatable?
item.description: The healthfulness of ultra-processed foods often sparks debate, particularly regarding the definitions of "hyper-palatable." Many associate these foods with being unnatural and inherently unhealthy, overlooking scientific considerations to the contrary.

item.title: New research extols the benefits of pecans
item.description: Conducted by researchers at the Illinois Institute of Technology, the review draws on an extensive body of research that underscores the relevance of pecans within today's eating patterns and health priorities.

item.title: Talenti introduces two new flavors
item.description: Chocolate Hazelnut Crunch Gelato blends smooth chocolate gelato with 100% roasted Italian hazelnuts, decadent fudge sauce, and crunchy chocolate cookie pieces for a rich, layered, comforting indulgence. Paradise Passionfruit Sorbetto is a refreshing, tropical addition to Talenti's sorbetto lineup.

item.title: Agropur posts $8.9B in 2025 revenues
item.description: The results represent 2% growth compared to 2024.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's parent company announces first earnings results
item.description: The Magnum Ice Cream Co.'s fiscal year 2025 earnings came in 7.9 billion euros (approximately $9.38 million U.S. dollars), +4.2% organic sales growth (OSG) year-on-year, with volume growth +1.5% and price growth +2.6%. Operating Profit was 599 million euros, (approximately $711 million U.S. dollars).

item.title: The protein power of cottage cheese, yogurt fuels Olympic and FIFA World Cup athletes
item.description: With the 2026 Winter Olympics taking place this month and the upcoming FIFA World Cup, cultured dairy is playing an important part in athletes' training and recovery. Protein-packed products are in high demand.

item.title: Dairy Farmers of America to receive up to $46M grant from USDA
item.description: This grant is especially meaningful for small farms, many of which are interested in conservation practices and can benefit from additional resources to make implementation more accessible.

item.title: Amcor polypropylene beverage cups qualify as “Widely Recyclable”
item.description: This milestone reflects years of industry collaboration to align packaging design, recycling infrastructure, end markets and consumer guidance.
